model: F8J251 (30 W, two ports: USB-C and USB-A)
notes: A 30 W two-port car charger (USB-C 18 W PD, USB-A 12 W, 12 V DC input) with a USB-C cable in the box. The parts are from the August 2019 teardown unit; other Belkin car chargers may use different parts.

gaps: No datasheet link is given for the CX8850, HUSB338L or TDM3307A: the research agent found none and it was not searched again.
The article calls TDM3307A only a VBUS switch and does not say what kind of device it is, so it is filed under the switch part type, not mosfet.
The article's layout line lists one output filter inductor and a photo is captioned '3R3 filter inductor'; it does not say whether they are the same part, and no inductance is given.

The layout line lists two output filter solid capacitors; the USB-C (16 V 470 uF) and USB-A (6.3 V 330 uF) output capacitors are probably those two, but the article does not say, so the solid capacitors are not listed separately.
No quantity is set where the article gives no count.
The research record put the spring-loaded pin on the USB-C port; the article puts the spring at the input positive end, so it is a separate part here.
No fuse or diode is claimed; the article names none.
No retail listing for F8J251 was opened, so variants sold under that model are unknown.
method: Re-sourced 2026-11-12 under the project owner's rule not to cite ChargerLAB: the research agent's English-language teardown is not cited, every claim was re-checked against the Chinese original on chongdiantou.com, and claims only the English page supported were dropped.

充电头网 (chongdiantou.com) teardown of the belkin 30W USB PD fast-charge car charger (1A1C), model F8J251, 2019-08-12: https://www.chongdiantou.com/archives/37489.html. Only this one article page was opened; no archive pages or reposts.
The article names the chip makers in Chinese (慧能泰, 诚芯微, 泰德, 艾华); Hynetek, Chengxinwei, Techcode and AiSHi are their usual English names.

comps.spec: Two Chengxinwei (诚芯微) CX8850 step-down DC-DC controllers, one per output; input limit 40 V, 4 A continuous output, up to 98% duty cycle, built-in 20 mOhm high-side and low-side NMOS
Hynetek (慧能泰) HUSB338L USB-C power delivery controller for the USB-C output, SOP-14L or QFN-16L package options; PD3.0, PD2.0, PPS, HVDCP and BC1.2
Techcode (泰德) TDM3307A, the USB-C port's VBUS switch
Output filter inductor; a photo is captioned 3R3 filter inductor
AiSHi (艾华) input filter electrolytic capacitor, 35 V 10 uF
USB-C output filter capacitor, 16 V 470 uF
USB-A output filter capacitor, 6.3 V 330 uF
USB-A and USB-C output ports stacked one above the other, both with black tongues; the USB-C port is on a small PCB soldered to the main board
Input positive contact is a spring, with a metal baffle soldered to the spring's tail so it does not deform under pressure
One LED indicator beside the output ports, lit green when the charger is powered
